cooldown: linear base LR -> 0, restoring optimizer/moments and all RNG states from a stable checkpoint; fork never changes the stable trunk
budget_definition: B = stable fork update + 2500 cooldown updates; initial budgets 12500/22500/32500, optional 52500
extension_rule: Extend all three stable trunks to 50000 and add a 2500-update cooldown there if any method/domain improves >0.3 between raw stable 27500 and 30000 OR between cooled 20000 and 30000 forks. Stable extension holds the BASE LR, with no replayed warmup or decay.
budget_rule: Smallest cooled B with all nine absolute MAE differences to the final cooled reference <=0.3 and identical per-domain pairwise ranks at that fork and the next actual cooled fork. Never invent a successor for the terminal fork.
extension_cap: If raw 47500->50000 OR cooled 30000->50000 still improves >0.3 in any cell, mark insufficient evidence; no further automatic extension

training_probe.selection: reuse fixed train-probe-v1 hash protocol; training split only; no augmentation

formal_grid: locked; candidate budget requires common clipping review and a separate formal config; later formal WSD uses B-2500 stable updates plus 2500 cooldown
